messages:
Priya (Procurement): looping in the crew — BidHarbor submitted a draft SOW + rate card for their inference cost-metering. quick q: does their commit/credit model map to how we actually consume tokens/embeddings?
Amelia (Finance): saw the doc. looks like commits are expressed as 'compute credits' not tokens. need clarity on conversion and overage math.
Jon S (Eng Ops): for the POC we ran ~1.2M inference tokens + 45k embeddings. how would that be represented in their billing?
Arjun - BidHarbor: thanks Priya — hi all. commit = compute credits. short version: 1 credit ~= 1k inference tokens OR 10 embeddings (standard embedding unit). We can provide custom mapping if you prefer token-first.
Sasha R (Platform): hmm 1 credit to both tokens & embeddings is noisy. what's the delta when you hit long sequences? does the credit model scale with seq length?
Arjun - BidHarbor: good call. our engine uses a sequence multiplier for >1024 context. example: 2x multiplier for sequences 1024-4096. we'll attach the multiplier table.
Priya (Procurement): also need to confirm rollover and unused-commit behavior. last vendor we used expired credits quarterly and made recon painful.
Arjun - BidHarbor: we support two commit flavors: quarterly rollover up to 30% unused, or annual rollover up to 100% with a small fee. both include a monthly reconciliation statement.
Amelia (Finance): what about invoice cadence and payment terms? we prefer net-45 for pilots, net-30 for signed deals. any leeway on net-45 for a 6mo POC?
Arjun - BidHarbor: can do net-45 on pilot with PO up front. for enterprise contracts we default to net-30.
Jon S (Eng Ops): question on metering: does BidHarbor send per-request logs with token counts for recon? we need per-route breakdown to map to our cost routes.
Arjun - BidHarbor: yes — per-request CSV with request_id, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, embedding_units, timestamp. can push to your S3 or share via secure link.
Priya (Procurement): penalty/early-termination? our legal will ask.
Arjun - BidHarbor: standard: 30-day termination with pro-rata refund on annual with >6 months remaining, else no refund. we can discuss exceptions for startups.
Sasha R (Platform): onboarding/implementation costs? they listed a $12k setup fee for private VPC config. is that negotiable?
Arjun - BidHarbor: setup fee covers dedicated network config and compliance checks. we can reduce to $6k if you commit to a 12mo annual plan.
Amelia (Finance): we also need a sample invoice line itemization to feed into our AP parser. can you provide a mock invoice showing credits used + overages + taxes?
Arjun - BidHarbor: attaching a mock invoice in the thread (CSV and PDF). sample lines: "Quarterly commit (Q2) — 150k credits, $45,000", "Overage — 12,300 credits, $3,690", "Setup fee — $6,000".
Priya (Procurement): accounting bot — once we have the mock invoice can you run it through the parser and flag mapping issues?
Accounting Bot: sure, drop the CSV link and I'll run a dry pass and post mapping diffs.
Jon S (Eng Ops): one more: do they have a discounted preemption path? e.g., if we accept best-effort instances for non-critical batch jobs, can we get 40% off those credits?
Arjun - BidHarbor: yes — 'spot' credits available at 35-45% discount depending on region and model. spot cannot be used for low-latency routes, only batch.
Sasha R (Platform): security/compliance: SOC2 + KMS options? we need E2E encryption and customer-managed keys for Private.
Arjun - BidHarbor: SOC2 Type II available. for Private we support bring-your-own-key (BYOK) via AWS KMS or HashiCorp HSM.
Priya (Procurement): next steps I propose: 1) confirm the credit multiplier table from Arjun, 2) Accounting Bot runs mock invoice, 3) Amelia confirm net-45 pilot approval, 4) Sasha validate BYOK and spot-credit applicability. can everyone ack?
Amelia (Finance): ack — will confirm budget ceiling by EOD tomorrow.
Jon S (Eng Ops): ack — will test the per-request CSV format on our sample 1.2M tokens dump and report parsing issues.
Sasha R (Platform): ack — will spin up a quick POC with spot and low-latency model to validate routing rules.
Arjun - BidHarbor: thanks — I'll push the multiplier table + mock invoice link in 1hr and hold the $6k setup concession for 48hrs. ping me for a short sync if needed. :handshake:
Priya (Procurement): thanks Arjun. cc legal once we have the mock invoice and final commit sizes.
Accounting Bot: mock invoice received and queued for parse — will post results in ~2hrs.
